9900002 - Denial of Service in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP (Internet Communication Manager, HTTP/2)
SAP Security Note, Version: 3, Released On: 2026.11.12
Component: BC-CST-IC   Priority: High   CVSS v3.0 Base Score: 7.5

Symptom
An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted HTTP/2 requests that make the ICM unavailable.

Reason and Prerequisites
Systems are only affected if HTTP/2 support is enabled in the ICM (profile parameter icm/HTTP/support_http2 = TRUE). Systems with HTTP/2 support disabled are not affected, whatever their kernel patch level.

Solution
The correction is delivered with the kernel patch level listed in "Support Packages & Patches". All higher patch levels also contain the correction.

Workaround
Set profile parameter icm/HTTP/support_http2 = FALSE and restart the ICM.

Software Components (From - To)
KERNEL 7.53 - 7.53
KERNEL 7.77 - 7.77

Support Package Patches
SAP KERNEL 7.53 64-BIT UNICODE   SP1210   001210
SAP KERNEL 7.77 64-BIT UNICODE   SP650    000650
